texts: On day 3 of Year 1, the keepers of the East Row together lit the lanterns of the East Row at sundown.
The keepers of the East Row tended the lanterns that night.
The lanterns showed mist-light at night.
Many of the nightmoths gathered at the lanterns.
The nightmoths landed on the lanterns.
The nightmoths left silken threads on the lanterns.
Pell collected the silken threads from the lanterns at dawn on day 4 of Year 1.
Hesper boiled the silken threads in sea-water on day 4 of Year 1.
Mire-essence formed in a cauldron by evening.
Hesper stored the mire-essence in two clay vessels.
The keepers of the East Row lit the lanterns of the East Row with the stored mire-essence at sundown on day 4 of Year 1.

q1_issues.issue: "The nightmoths left silken threads on the lanterns" gives the threads Patient, but leaving/depositing does not create, destroy, consume or physically change them, so the stated change test yields Theme (the same choice is repeated inside the rule at index 65).

q2_gaps: of-phrase on an agent-nominalization ("the keepers of the East Row"): the nominalization-object `Of` oblique is defined for nouns naming an act, result or quality, while the agent-nominalization section says a referring use is an ordinary kind -- neither settles whether "keepers of X" takes `Of` or the genitive `Possession`, and the parse uses `Of` here but `Possession` for "the lanterns of the East Row" in the same sentence
partitive level word "many" ("Many of the nightmoths gathered"): the enumerated vague-word lexicon for the `ProportionOf` level slot is most / half / some / few / none and does not cover "many"
review.notes: The collective/distributive contrast is handled correctly throughout -- "together lit" and "Together, the lanterns produced" get group-only events while the unmarked plural clauses add the per-member rule, and collective "gathered" stays group-only. Compound decomposition (mire_essence, mist_light, nightmoth, silken_thread, sea_water, clay_vessel), the "that night" term propagation, the "by evening" TimeAtMost and the partitive superset reuse of sk_nightmoths_1 all follow the instruction set.

issues.reason: Thematic roles decides by the one change test and leaving/depositing threads on the lanterns neither creates, destroys, consumes nor physically changes them (and "when the test is unclear, default to Theme"), so (Patient sk_leave_1 sk_threads_1) and the same slot inside leave_rule assert a change the verb does not make.

gaps_confirmed: agent-nominalization of-phrase ("the keepers of the East Row"): the Of oblique is defined for nouns naming an act/result/quality and the genitive Possession for relational nouns with no underlying verb, and "keeper" is a role noun that does have one -- neither route is settled
partitive level slot has no entry for "many" ("Many of the nightmoths gathered"): the vague-word lexicon for ProportionOf is most / half / some / few / none
new_gaps: non-Gregorian day-of-year dating ("on day 3 of Year 1"): (Day n) is the day-of-month granularity term, so a day index stated with no month is stored indistinguishably from a day-of-month -- no term carries an ordinal day-of-year

a bare MASS NP first mentioned in an episodic clause and then re-referred by a definite ("produced mist-light ... The mist-light attracted ..."; "Mire-essence formed ... the mire-essence"): the episodic rule mints a group witness for bare PLURALS and reserves the bare kind symbol for non-specific objects, but says nothing about a mass NP that must later host anaphora, which is why sk_mist_light_1 / sk_mire_essence_1 had to be improvised
adjudication.defect_summary: The compliant form is (Theme sk_leave_1 sk_threads_1) in the flat event and (Theme (sk_leave $x) (sk_threads $x)) in the per-member rule's conclusion, everything else in the leave bundle unchanged.
adjudication.notes: The rest tracks doctrine: the together-marked collective vs unmarked distributive split, the "that night" term propagation, the "by evening" TimeAtMost, and the compound decompositions (mire_essence, mist_light, nightmoth, silken_thread with its material-adjective modifier genus, sea_water, clay_vessel with none). The differing Of / Possession treatment of the two of-phrases in sentence 1 is defensible rather than inconsistent -- the verb-paraphrase test separates a nominalization's argument from an ordinary genitive.
